baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same ع ل م root occurs in the causative opening verb and the negated final verb, enclosing the human recipient and the unknown object.
baseline_models.mechanism: Teaching causes a passage across an epistemic boundary: what had not entered the human's awareness becomes disclosed to that human.

activation_trace.role: Emergence into clarity supplies the state change, while the doubled root assigns its cause to teaching and its result to human knowing.
Perceptual detection makes the human a locus in which an absent object can enter sensed awareness.

changed_reading.before: A teacher transfers unspecified information to a human.
changed_reading.after: The verse stages a caused transition from non-apprehension to disclosed awareness, with the human as the changed locus.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: عَلَّمَ and يَعْلَمْ frame the human and the open relative مَا, allowing the mark-image of ع ل م to organize the construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: Teaching places distinctions that point beyond themselves; knowing is the ability to follow those marks into territory that previously had no usable bearings.

activation_trace.role: A differentiating trace that guides toward its referent turns teaching into the production of epistemic bearings.
The person-facing side gives the marks an orientation toward a situated human recipient rather than leaving them as inert signs.

changed_reading.before: Knowledge is an abstract possession placed in the learner.
changed_reading.after: Knowledge is an orienting system of distinctions by which the human can find what was formerly inaccessible.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The human stands between teaching and the clause of prior non-knowing, so the change can be read affectively as well as cognitively.
baseline_models.mechanism: Instruction removes the estrangement of the unknown: disclosure does not merely add content but makes an alien field perceptible and inhabitable.

activation_trace.role: Familiar comfort replacing estrangement supplies the relational change undergone by the human before the unknown.
Disclosure provides the cognitive mechanism through which estranged material becomes available for familiarity.

changed_reading.before: Teaching corrects a deficit of information.
changed_reading.after: Teaching brings the human into familiarity with a reality that had remained cognitively estranged.

context_deltas.mechanism: Reading gathers differentiated traces; the name supplies a visible identifying mark, creation supplies measured structure, and lordly nurture sustains the learner. Together they turn the focus teaching into induction into a legible created order.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch supplies the guiding marks whose wider environment becomes legible.
Gathering supplies the operation by which separate marks become an intelligible configuration.
The non-dominant mapped branch contributes an identifying visible trace, linking naming to the focus model of knowledge as marking.
Cultivation and completion make legibility part of an ongoing formative relation.
Measured formation supplies an ordered field in which differentiating marks can guide.

structural_cues: 96:1 orders reading through a name and immediately predicates creation; 96:5 returns to teaching after that reading-creation sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathering, marking, measuring, and nurturing images; I supply the arrow that treats created distinctions as the curriculum of teaching. A live alternative is that these cues identify the teacher's authority without specifying how knowledge works.

changed_reading.before: The focus marks are private distinctions installed inside one learner.
changed_reading.after: Teaching equips the human to gather and navigate marks already distributed through a measured, named, and cultivated world.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same human moves from created attachment to perceptive knowing, while generosity characterizes the source. Teaching therefore reads as a second phase of formation that converts radical dependence into receptive capacity without erasing dependence.

activation_trace.role: The focus human is defined as capable of sensing what enters awareness, the capacity produced by the formative sequence.
Disclosure names the later formative threshold reached by the created human.
Bringing the human into existence supplies the first formation to which teaching can be read as a continuation.
Repeated visible human presence identifies the created dependent and the taught recipient as the same kind of being.
Attachment and dependence supply the initial condition from which epistemic capacity develops.
Commendable generosity casts the transition into knowledge as gift rather than autonomous achievement.

structural_cues: 96:2 and 96:5 repeat ٱلْإِنسَانَ as the object first of creation and then of teaching.
The creation, generosity, pen, and teaching clauses form a sequence before the adversative turn at 96:6.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated human objects, attachment, creation, disclosure, and generosity; I infer that teaching continues rather than merely follows creation. The alternative is a list of distinct favors with no developmental arrow.

changed_reading.before: A fully formed human later receives information.
changed_reading.after: The human's capacity to know is itself a gifted phase of formation emerging from, and still bearing, creaturely dependence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent pen clause materializes the focus mark-model: a hard object is pared to make writing, and its cut point deposits durable distinctions outside the learner. Teaching can therefore preserve and reactivate disclosure across absence and time.

activation_trace.role: A distinction that points beyond itself supplies the semiotic function of the written trace.
The repeated teaching verb explicitly joins the focus act to the pen-mediated marking process.
Paring a hard object supplies the selective cutting that produces a precise marking edge.
The prepared writing stick supplies the external carrier on which distinctions outlast immediate awareness.

structural_cues: 96:4 and 96:5 are adjacent relative clauses with repeated عَلَّمَ; the first names an instrument and the second expands to an open object مَا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies teaching with a pared writing instrument and the focus branch of a guiding mark; I infer that inscription externalizes memory and extends disclosure through time. The alternative is that the pen is simply one instrument among others, without the cutting mechanism carrying interpretive force.

changed_reading.before: Teaching produces an immediate inward awareness.
changed_reading.after: Teaching can cut durable, retrievable distinctions into an external medium, letting the unknown become knowable beyond the teacher's or learner's immediate presence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The taught and perceiving human can turn acquired disclosure into a self-confirming gaze: seeing the self as sufficient converts received capacity into boundary-crossing agency. Knowledge is thus enabling but not self-correcting.

activation_trace.role: Received disclosure supplies the capacity that can subsequently be appropriated as if it were self-originating.
Perceptual awareness supplies the human faculty that later folds back into self-perception.
The repeated human designation keeps the morally dangerous agent continuous with the immediately preceding taught recipient.
Exceeding a limit supplies the behavioral result of treating received capacity as autonomous.
Vision and insight supply the reflexive act by which the human constructs a verdict about the self.
Claimed self-sufficiency supplies the false interpretation imposed on a gifted epistemic capacity.

structural_cues: 96:6 immediately repeats ٱلْإِنسَانَ after the taught human of 96:5.
96:7 grammatically presents self-perceived sufficiency as the reason for the transgression announced in 96:6.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies continuity of the human and the causal move from self-seeing as sufficient to transgression; I infer that recently named teaching is one capacity vulnerable to this appropriation. A live alternative is that the sufficiency is economic or social and does not arise from learning.

changed_reading.before: Once ignorance is replaced by knowledge, the human is straightforwardly improved.
changed_reading.after: Teaching opens real capacity, but the learner can misattribute the gift to the self and use disclosed power to cross limits.

context_deltas.mechanism: A form-distant water sequence activates around the focus root: knowledge is a gathered reservoir, transgression is its boundary-breaking overflow, return is recirculation toward the sustaining source, and restraint is the terminus where flow can be contained.

activation_trace.role: A large gathered body of water supplies the focus image of accumulated epistemic capacity.
Water rising into a sweeping force supplies the change from useful accumulation to limit-breaking excess.
Abundant water associates the destination of return with the sustaining source rather than with human possession.
Returning water supplies recirculation after overflow and prevents the reservoir from reading as self-originating.
Water settling at a torrent's endpoint supplies a containing terminus for a flow that must cease exceeding its bounds.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from teaching to overflow, then return, and later to an ultimatum of ending or restraint.
The packet distributes water images across the otherwise distinct roots for knowledge, transgression, lordship, return, and ending.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies each water image but does not state one continuous metaphor; I align them into a hydrological analogy and assign ethical direction from gathering through overflow to return and containment. The live alternative is the ordinary moral sequence with no cross-root water mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Knowledge is static content possessed by the human.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, knowledge behaves like gathered flow whose benefit depends on bounded circulation and whose appropriation as a private reservoir can become destructive overflow.

context_deltas.mechanism: The teacher is also the destination of return. Disclosure is not a one-way transfer that leaves the learner sovereign; it establishes a capacity that remains inside a relation of source, cultivation, and eventual answerability.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure supplies the granted capacity whose direction is revised by the return clause.
Sovereign lordship identifies the source and destination as one authority rather than a peer instructor.
Return to a prior source bends the apparently linear transfer of teaching back into accountability.

structural_cues: The second-person possessive in رَبِّكَ recurs around the opening teaching sequence and at the destination of return.
96:8 follows the human's claim of self-sufficiency with an emphatic return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lordship and return immediately after self-sufficiency; I infer that the return also governs how the teaching gift is held. The alternative is that return concerns final destiny without specifically revising the epistemic relation in 96:5.

changed_reading.before: Teaching moves knowledge from giver to learner and ends in learner possession.
changed_reading.after: Teaching grants a capacity that remains answerable to its cultivating source and is folded into a trajectory of return.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated demands to see test whether taught discrimination can recognize a guided act or instead become prohibition. Guidance gives knowledge a path, while protective restraint gives it an enacted ethical boundary.

activation_trace.role: A mark that points toward something supplies the focus capacity for distinguishing and following a route.
The alerting interrogative turns perception into an examination of the hearer's judgment.
Blocking an act supplies the negative practical use to which discernment can be bent.
Gentle indication toward a true path converts the focus marker-image into lived direction.
Placing oneself within protection supplies the ethical boundary enacted by rightly followed guidance.

structural_cues: The repeated أَرَأَيْتَ questions frame a servant at prayer, being upon guidance, and commanding protective awareness.
The sequence contrasts the one who blocks with the one whose embodied act follows guidance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies interrogated seeing, prohibition, path-guidance, and self-protection; I infer that these scenes test the practical outcome of the capacity taught in 96:5. The alternative is a judicial denunciation of one blocker that does not define knowledge generally.

changed_reading.before: Knowing means successfully apprehending an object.
changed_reading.after: Knowing includes reading a moral situation, following a true direction, and refusing to turn discernment into obstruction.

context_deltas.mechanism: Denial and turning away culminate in a question about knowing that God sees. The focus movement from non-knowing to knowing is reopened as an accountable relation: the human knower is also an object of a more encompassing vision.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure supplies the capacity whose presence is later challenged by the question of whether the denier knows.
Contradicting truth supplies a mode in which available disclosure can be actively refused.
Turning away supplies the directional withdrawal that prevents disclosure from governing conduct.
The explicit return of knowing links the rebuke lexically to the focus transition out of non-knowing.
The one worshipped supplies the authoritative subject of the vision under which human knowing is assessed.
Comprehensive seeing reverses the learner's position from observer and possessor into observed and answerable subject.

structural_cues: 96:14 echoes the focus pair لَمْ يَعْلَمْ with أَلَمْ يَعْلَمْ and immediately supplies the content of that challenged knowing.
The human sees himself sufficient in 96:7, while 96:14 counters that self-gaze with God's seeing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lexical reprise, denial, withdrawal, and the counter-gaze; I infer that 96:14 reopens 96:5's non-knowing as a recurrent or willful failure, not merely an original deficit. The alternative is that 96:14 rebukes one act locally without revising the earlier teaching.

changed_reading.before: Knowledge is something the human gains and then possesses as a seeing subject.
changed_reading.after: Knowledge remains exposure to truth under an encompassing counter-gaze; it can be denied, and the knower is also known and seen.

context_deltas.mechanism: The singular taught human later stands amid rival summons: one call recruits a council, the answering call recruits agents of force. Teaching is thereby exposed as socially contestable formation rather than sealed private cognition.

activation_trace.role: Visible human presence anchors the learner as a social being who can stand among other human presences.
Guiding distinctions supply the formation that rival authorities may reinforce, suppress, or redirect.
A spoken summons supplies the mechanism by which one actor recruits support around a claimed reading of the situation.
The gathered council supplies a human institution capable of socially backing obstruction.
The answering summons creates deliberate symmetry and contests the first group's claim to effective authority.
Pushing, impact, and prevention supply coercive enforcement against the obstructing social formation.

structural_cues: 96:17 and 96:18 mirror each other with two calls, changing only the caller and the body summoned.
The focus names one human generically, while the later confrontation unfolds through assemblies and collective agents.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a taught human, paired summons, a council, and coercive responders; I infer that epistemic formation is recruited into competing social authorities. The alternative is that the paired calls concern power alone and leave the teaching of 96:5 untouched.

changed_reading.before: Teaching is a private change inside an individual human.
changed_reading.after: Teaching forms a socially situated knower whose marks and judgments can be contested, institutionalized, or opposed by rival collectives.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final imperatives give the taught capacity a bodily direction: refuse alignment with the blocker, lower the self, and draw near. The baseline removal of estrangement reaches an enacted proximity rather than stopping at mental familiarity.

activation_trace.role: Comfort that removes estrangement supplies the relational potential fulfilled as nearness.
Disclosure supplies the taught awareness that can issue in a chosen posture.
Submission and compliance, negated toward the blocker, supply the first practical discrimination required of the learner.
Bodily lowering supplies the reversal of self-sufficient elevation.
The overcoming of distance supplies the relational outcome toward which disclosure and lowered posture move.

structural_cues: 96:19 closes with three coordinated imperatives: rejected obedience, prostration, and approach.
The sequence reverses 96:7's self-elevation through an embodied lowering that produces nearness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies refusal, lowering, and approach; I infer that these are the enacted completion of teaching and familiarization in 96:5. The alternative is that the closing commands answer the persecutor locally without defining the telos of knowledge.

changed_reading.before: Teaching makes an unknown object mentally familiar.
changed_reading.after: Teaching can culminate in discriminating allegiance and embodied humility, through which estrangement gives way to lived nearness.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the specialized pupil-image branch of إنسان and nests it inside the later seeing sequence. It remains anchored in the focus noun and in the contrast between self-seeing and divine seeing, but downstream prose should present it only as an optical-relational echo, not as the lexical definition of الإنسان here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus recipient ٱلْإِنسَانَ can activate the tiny human image visible in an eye's pupil.

activation_trace.role: The human image held in the pupil makes the taught human not only a seeing subject but also an image present within sight.
View, appearance, and mirror imagery supplies the self-image through which the human judges itself sufficient.
A second, authoritative seeing contains the learner's self-image within a gaze the learner does not control.

changed_reading.before: The human is the autonomous subject who receives knowledge and then sees.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the learner is also an image held within another's sight, so self-knowledge is nested inside a prior counter-gaze.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is form-distant because the visible upper-lip cleft is a specialized nominal branch of ع ل م, not the ordinary teaching sense of the verb. It remains anchored through the focus root and the context's voiced reading and summons, but it should be rendered only as a material echo of opened, marked speech rather than a semantic replacement.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The repeated ع ل م root in the focus can carry a marginal image of a visible opening or mark at the upper lip.

activation_trace.role: A visible upper-lip opening supplies a bodily, articulatory site at which teaching can become voiced distinction.
Reading and recitation turn the bodily opening into articulated transmission.
Calling by speech shows voiced capacity moving outward to alter a social field.
Raised voice intensifies the passage from taught articulation to public summons.

changed_reading.before: Teaching changes an interior cognitive state.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material echo, teaching marks and opens articulation, allowing concealed awareness to become recited and socially audible.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it connects the focus's guiding-mark branch to the later seizure and description of a forelock. It remains anchored through the shared problem of visible direction and error, but downstream prose should qualify the forelock as metonymic evidence of agency rather than claim that knowledge is literally inscribed on the body.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus branch of ع ل م treats knowledge as a visible distinction that guides, while the later context localizes false and errant direction at the body's leading edge.

activation_trace.role: A visible guiding distinction supplies the epistemic mark against which embodied misdirection can be read.
Seizing by the forelock makes the agent's leading orientation physically answerable.
The forelock supplies a graspable leading edge on which direction and agency can be concentrated.
Opposition to truth supplies the first counter-mark borne by that leading edge.
Missing the right target supplies misdirection rather than mere absence of information.

changed_reading.before: Teaching provides signs that guide the human toward external objects.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, human conduct itself becomes a visible counter-sign: truthful guidance or errant direction is borne at the agent's leading edge.

strongest_changes: Creation from attachment and the repeated human object recast teaching as a gifted second formation, not an autonomous acquisition.
Reading, naming-as-marking, measured creation, and the pared pen turn disclosure into navigation through durable external signs.
The immediate self-sufficiency sequence shows that real learning can be appropriated into a false claim of autonomy and boundary-crossing power.
Return, the reprise of knowing under God's seeing, and the final movement from refused obedience to prostration and nearness make knowledge accountable, practical, and embodied.
A live exploratory hydrology links gathered knowledge, floodlike excess, returning water, and terminal containment without displacing the stronger moral readings.
summary.what_was_special: The doubled ع ل م in 96:5 sustained several mechanisms at once: disclosure, guiding mark, and even a form-distant gathered-water image. Context activated them differently through the pen, the split name-to-mark mapping, human self-sufficiency, the counter-gaze, rival summons, and final embodied approach, so no single synthesis should erase the coexistence.
remaining_uncertainties: The causal link from being taught to later transgression is reader-supplied; the explicit context only makes self-perceived sufficiency the cause of transgression.
The hydrological model is coherent across packet branches but depends on several form-distant images and must remain exploratory.
It is uncertain whether 96:14 deliberately reopens 96:5's prior non-knowing or only rebukes the blocker locally.
The cutting dimension of the pen and the social-authority reading are mechanisms activated by branch and sequence, not meanings forced by the surface clauses.
